label: List what is kept, by tier
description: Data graph behind customer.listByTier under the local profile: the records whose tier is the one asked for. The filter names a field of the collection's shape, and the checker holds it to that. The same graph as @customers/data/kept-list-by-tier.graph.json, against the store kept in PostgreSQL: a store is named statically at a call site, so pointing these at another connection is a copy until a profile may swap one.
